goal: Find out whether the caller was really charged twice for two $89 charges on their card.

caller_notes: Caller sees two $89 charges on their card and worries they paid twice. Asks to confirm they are not actually paying twice. Satisfied once told what to expect, with no other asks and no booking.
facts_required: Two charges are usually one pending authorization that drops off in 3-5 business days
If both charges post, contact Meridian and they will open a case with the payment processor
